column1: # Oniscus package manifest: which files of this tree go into which RPM.
# Read by oniscus.spec (to install and list the files) and by build.sh (to drop
# these files from the image overlay when the ISO uses the packages instead).
#   package  source (relative to the repository root)  destination  flags
# A source directory is copied whole. Flags, comma-separated or "-":
#   config  %config(noreplace): updates never overwrite a file the admin changed
#   own     the package also owns the destination directory (and its subdirectories)
# Files under /usr/local in the overlay move to /usr in the packages (packages must
# not touch /usr/local). System defaults that the overlay puts in /etc/xdg go to
# /etc/xdg/oniscus instead, so they never clash with files owned by XFCE or openSUSE
# packages; the Oniscus session puts that directory first in XDG_CONFIG_DIRS.
# Not packaged on purpose (they stay in kiwi/root and only reach the image):
#   etc/ly/config.ini              owned by the ly package
#   etc/dconf/profile/user         may be owned by dconf
#   etc/bash.bashrc.local          admin file; the Release image gets a stub that
